name: MetaNLR++
definition: A neural rendering approach that combines a neural shape representation (implicit surface) and 2D CNN-based image feature extraction, aggregation, and re-projection, accelerated by meta learning to achieve fast training and real-time rendering.
summary: MetaNLR++ is a neural rendering method for novel view synthesis that uses meta-learning for fast training, sphere tracing for explicit surfaces, and deep feature blending to inpaint geometry errors.
